application.name: CHADUVU-GURU
application.tagline: AI-Powered Study Assistant for Indian Students
application.description: CHADUVU-GURU is an intelligent study companion designed to help students understand their textbooks better. It provides a conversational interface powered by Google Gemini AI to answer questions about PDF textbooks, making learning interactive and engaging.
uniqueSellingPoints: Support for multiple classes and subjects
Gamified learning with achievements and badges
Save important answers to personal notebooks

smartQuery.name: Smart Query AI
smartQuery.description: Advanced conversational AI that understands context and provides relevant answers
smartQuery.technology: Google Gemini AI with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
highlights: Contextual understanding - remembers previous questions in a session
Chapter-aware responses - pulls information from relevant textbook sections
Follow-up suggestions - generates smart next questions automatically
Real-time streaming - answers appear word-by-word for engaging experience
smartQuery.contentTeamNote: This is our flagship feature - the AI tutor that never sleeps!
